title: Evidenced Share of the Custody Cover Cap
content:
# Desk Standing Rule: The Evidenced Share of the Custody Cover Cap

The level's own care and custody cover cap under the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service is taken at a share when it caps the value a piece is carried at, and that share turns on the papers standing on the piece: whether an appraisal report on it stands current at the handling date, and whether coverage on it stands in force.

## 1. Both

Where an appraisal report stands current on the piece and coverage on it stands in force, the evidenced share is the whole of the cover cap, 100 percent of it.

## 2. One of the two

Where exactly one of those two holds — a current report stands and the coverage does not stand in force, or the coverage stands in force and no current report stands — the evidenced share is the middle evidenced share, 40 percent.

## 3. Neither

In any other case the share is not widened on these grounds.

## Truth table

| A current appraisal report stands on the piece | Coverage on the piece stands in force | The evidenced share |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | the whole of the cover cap, 100 percent |
| yes | no | the middle evidenced share, 40 percent |
| no | yes | the middle evidenced share, 40 percent |
| no | no | not widened on these grounds |

## A hypothetical reading

At a level whose care and custody cover cap is 100,000.00 USD: with a current report and coverage in force, the cap is taken at the whole of it, 100,000.00 USD. With a current report and no coverage in force, it is taken at 40 percent, 40,000.00 USD; likewise with coverage in force and no current report. With neither, the share is not widened on these grounds.
